title: Tenure and the Benefit That Goes Across with a Transferred Piece
content:
How much of the benefit standing on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans goes across when the piece passes to a new owner turns on how long the plan has been in force, counted in whole years.

Where the whole years the plan has been in force stand above 5, the whole of the benefit standing carries across. Where those whole years stand above 2 but not above 5, 90 percent of the benefit standing carries across. In any other case 70 percent of the benefit standing carries across.

## What each length of tenure carries

| Whole years the plan has been in force | The part of the benefit standing that carries across |
|---|---|
| more than 5 | the whole of it |
| more than 2, and 5 or fewer | 90 percent |
| 2 or fewer | 70 percent |

The whole years in question are the whole years between the day coverage began and the handling date, part years dropped.

## Boundary readings

A plan in force for exactly 5 whole years carries 90 percent of the benefit standing, because the whole of it requires more than 5 whole years; at 6 whole years the whole of it carries across. A plan in force for exactly 2 whole years carries 70 percent, because the 90 percent reading requires more than 2 whole years; at 3 whole years it carries 90 percent. On a benefit standing of 2000.00 USD those three readings give 2000.00 USD, 1800.00 USD and 1400.00 USD.
